title: RDT based upper bounds on the largest average submatrix values
summary: We study statistical variants of the classical largest average submatrix problem. For small submatrices (where the dimension is less than linearly proportional to the original matrix), the problem is typically well understood and believed to exhibit the statistical-computational gap (SCG). However, analytical treatment of both the information-theoretic and algorithmic aspects of the linear regime remains challenging, and no mathematically rigorous results have yet arrived anywhere close to proving or disproving SCG existence in this setting.
